title: [Nichibei] Lesson Booking – Filter Page – Back Button – Navigates to Reservation List
description: #23 — Scenario — In the Lesson Booking System on the learner app, tapping the "<" back button from the Filter page navigates to the Reservation List, not the Bookable Lesson List.
preconditions:
- Logged in as a student to the Nichibei learner app
- Student has navigated to Lesson Booking > Filter page
steps_type:
1. "Open the Nichibei learner app and navigate to Lesson Booking"
2. "Open the Filter page (tap Filter button)"
3. "Tap the < back button without applying any filter"
4. "Observe the destination screen"
steps_actions:
1. "Lesson Booking screen shown"
2. "Filter page shown"
3. "Navigation occurs"
4. "Reservation List screen is shown (not the Bookable Lesson List)"
